wechat-search-weread v0.1.0

- Initial release of WeChat Read public account article search skill.
- Allows searching WeChat public account articles via WeRead’s “搜一搜”, returning title, official account, publish date, summary, thumbnail, and article URL.
- Requires agent-browser and valid WeRead login session.
- Offers complete workflow instructions for browser interaction, WeRead login (including QR code extraction), search, scroll, data extraction, and session management.
- Designed for use when Exa and Sogou search methods are insufficient.
